title: A Kosmocentric Orientation: Andrew Cohen
text: [Music] do you want to begin to see your experience as part and parcel of a Continuum so the Continuum that I'm speaking about began with the first cause or when the universe was created when something came from nothing that's when the whole process began so that's when this Continuum that's when time began and so we want to begin to learn how to see your own experience as the Leading Edge as the most sophisticated most complex expression of of a process that started 14 billion years [Music] ago and when you really begin to get this not just at a rational level but that's a good place to start but when you begin to see it and feel it you you begin to relate your own experience of being alive and your own experience of Consciousness to the evolution of the [Music] cosmos so the reason why this is so important this particular time in history is because more and more of us have to begin to get this so we're going to pull ourselves out of this narcissistic nightmare and discover the inherently thrilling nature and the sense of ultimate sacred importance of of of who we are and what we and what we're a part of and what we can actually do [Music]
